findings: `components[1].sound[0].system` mislabels Baxter–Sagart’s Middle Chinese readings as “Middle Chinese, Baxter–Sagart 2014.” The cited local rows identify Baxter–Sagart as the Old Chinese reconstruction source and give Middle Chinese values separately; correct the system attribution to the source-supported Middle Chinese system, retaining the readings only if the evidence identifies their system. The sound limitation’s phrase “The Middle Chinese readings are dzraeH and tsak” also needs the same correction or qualification, since those cited values are not independently established here as Middle Chinese readings from Baxter–Sagart.
